summary: NVIDIA's hyperflare-inference (Flare) v0.4.0 compresses prefix-cache checkpoints losslessly on the GPU at the VRAM to DRAM boundary, with a matching Rust CPU decoder, so revisited long sessions restore instead of recomputing.
